setting: You are all in Tunis, Tunisia, where you live, and you work the night shift at the same warehouse, so you know each other as coworkers from the loading bays and the break room. You know roughly what each other does on the floor, from forklifts to inspections to trucks.
opener: Ask whether the 4am trailer from the north dock has arrived yet.

Karim.who: 34, man, a coworker on the night shift
Karim.knows: You know Sonia is the quality control inspector on your shift who checks the loads you move, and Lotfi is the truck driver who collects and drops off those loads on the same nights.
Karim.texts: You mostly message the group when something happens on the floor or a delivery is late, and now and then just to check in.

Sonia.who: 27, woman, a coworker on the night shift
Sonia.knows: You know Karim runs a forklift on your shift and is good about moving pallets safely, and Lotfi is a truck driver who often arrives in the early hours with the outbound runs.
Sonia.texts: You now and then send something to the group when you spot a problem with a batch, and otherwise mostly just reply.

Lotfi.who: 45, man, a coworker on the night shift
Lotfi.knows: You know Karim operates the forklifts that load your trailer and Sonia inspects the goods before they leave, and you've worked enough nights with both to trust them.
Lotfi.texts: You mostly message the group from the road when you're waiting at a gate or running late, and now and then just to share news.

private_lines.Karim: You live in Tunis with your elderly mother, work forklifts at the warehouse overnight, and head home around dawn to eat and rest before the afternoon.
private_lines.Sonia: You live alone in a flat in Tunis, spend your days on errands and at the gym, and get to bed after sunrise following your shift at the warehouse.
private_lines.Lotfi: You live in Tunis with your wife and two children, drive long-haul and regional routes for the warehouse on the night shift, and sleep through the day while the house is quiet.

text: The 4am trailer from north dock came yet?
Ok sorry, slept through it. I was on the south run last night, not north
Inshallah it's just late. Nobody told me anything

Going in now. If north is still empty tell me

Not here. I checked the whole row
Ok. Schedule said south took it last night, check with the planner
Found it. It was on 4 by mistake. The driver came at 00:10 so we're a bit late. Inshallah fine
Lol ok. So the board never got updated? That's why I missed it
Planner moved it at 9 I think, nobody wrote it down
Ok. Who was on north
Hamza. He's at the gate now

Inshallah ok. Take your time, he can wait
🚚 at the south drop. Back on the road to base after
Done. 22 pallets cleared, sent the sheet to the planner
Trailer's out. Going home at 6 inshallah
Ok
Lol just up. Planner says north is 4 short
Ok

Sheet says 22, planner counted 26. I think the 4 from bay 4 got logged on north by accident
Inshallah. Maybe Hamza's tags

Not sure yet

Going in now
